description.value: Your augmentations are hidden under sheets of lab-grown flesh or synthetic alternatives, enabling you to pass as an unaugmented being without arousing suspicion. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, creatures perceive you as an unaugmented member of your ancestry and don't realize you're a cyborg or you have the tech trait. A creature that succeeds at a Perception check to [[/act seek dc=deception]] against your Deception DC notices the tech, but unless they get a critical success or are specifically looking for a cyborg, they are likely to assume you simply have augmentations.
